# m68k, Motorola syntax, against `vasmm68k_mot -no-opt -devpac` for a 68020
# with a 68881 and a 68851.
#
# For the FPU and MMU instructions, and above all the float immediates,
# where GNU as is wrong: it writes an extended-precision immediate without
# the 68881 format's 16 zero bits, and refuses packed decimal. vasm writes
# both from a C double, as rsasm does. The rule of m68k-vasm.txt holds
# here too: nothing with a size choice in it.
#
# Left out: `pmove srp,<ea>`, which GNU as takes for the 68030 and vasm only
# for the 68851.

 fmove.x fp0,fp1
 fmove.x fp7,fp0
 fadd.x fp1,fp2
 fsub.x fp3,fp4
 fmul.x fp5,fp6
 fdiv.x fp7,fp0
 fsqrt.x fp0,fp1
 fabs.x fp2
 fneg.x fp3,fp3
 fmove.s #1.5,fp0
 fmove.d #1.5,fp0
 fmove.x #1.5,fp0
 fmove.p #1.5,fp0
 fmove.x #0.1,fp1
 fmove.x #-2.5,fp2
 fmove.x #3.14159,fp3
 fmove.x #1.0e10,fp4
 fmove.x #-1.0e-5,fp5
 fmove.p #0.1,fp1
 fmove.p #-1.0e-5,fp2
 fmove.p #12345.678,fp3
 fmove.p #3.14159,fp4
 fmove.s #-0.1,fp1
 fmove.d #2.718281828,fp1
 fadd.s #0.5,fp1
 fsub.d #100.25,fp2
 fcmp.x #1.0,fp0
 fmove.l d0,fp0
 fmove.w d1,fp2
 fmove.b d2,fp3
 fmove.l fp0,d0
 fmove.w fp1,d1
 fmove.b fp2,d2
 fmove.x (a0),fp0
 fmove.x fp0,(a0)
 fmove.x (a0)+,fp1
 fmove.x fp1,-(a7)
 fmove.d $10(a0),fp2
 fmove.s fp3,$20(a1)
 fmove.x 4(a0,d0.w),fp4
 fmove.x 4(a0,d0.l*4),fp5
 fmove.l #1,fp0
 fmove.w #$1234,fp0
 fmove.b #$12,fp0
 fmove.l fpcr,d0
 fmove.l d0,fpcr
 fmove.l fpsr,(a0)
 fmove.l fpiar,d1
 fmovem.x fp0-fp3,-(a7)
 fmovem.x (a7)+,fp0-fp3
 fmovem.x fp0/fp2/fp4,(a0)
 fmovem.x (a0),fp1/fp3
 fmovem.l fpcr/fpsr,-(a7)
 fmovem.l (a7)+,fpcr/fpsr
 fmovem.l fpcr/fpsr/fpiar,(a0)
 fmovecr #$32,fp0
 fmovecr #0,fp1
 fsincos.x fp0,fp1:fp2
 fsincos.x (a0),fp3:fp4
 ftst.x fp0
 ftst.l d0
 ftst.x (a0)
 fint.x fp0,fp1
 fintrz.x fp2
 fetox.x fp0,fp1
 flogn.x fp2,fp3
 fsin.x fp0
 fcos.x fp1
 ftan.x fp2
 fatan.x fp3
 fgetexp.x fp0,fp1
 fgetman.x fp2,fp3
 fscale.l d0,fp0
 fmod.x fp1,fp2
 frem.x fp3,fp4
 fsgldiv.x fp0,fp1
 fsglmul.x fp2,fp3
 fnop
 fsave -(a7)
 frestore (a7)+
 fseq d0
 fsne (a0)
 fsgt -(a7)
 fsf d1
 fst d2
 ftrapeq
 ftrapne.w #1
 ftrapgt.l #$12345678
 fmove.p fp0,(a0){#5}
 fmove.p fp1,(a1){d2}
 pmove tc,(a0)
 pmove (a0),tc
 pmove crp,(a1)
 pmove psr,d0
 pmove d0,psr
 pflusha
 pflush #1,#2
 pflush #1,#2,(a0)
 ptestr #1,(a0),#7
 ptestw #1,(a0),#7,a1
 pvalid val,(a0)
 psave -(a7)
 prestore (a7)+
 cas.b d0,d1,(a0)
 cas.w d2,d3,(a1)
 cas.l d4,d5,(a2)
 cas2.w d0:d1,d2:d3,(a0):(a1)
 cas2.l d0:d1,d2:d3,(a0):(a1)
 callm #0,(a0)
 rtm d0
 pack d0,d1,#0
 pack -(a0),-(a1),#$30
 unpk d0,d1,#$3030
 unpk -(a0),-(a1),#0
 trapeq
 trapne.w #1
 traphi.l #$12345678
 movep.w d0,$10(a0)
 movep.l $20(a1),d1
 moves.b (a0),d0
 moves.w d1,(a1)
 moves.l (a2)+,a3
